description: This file contains a test implementation class 'BlockPoolMonitorForTesting' that implements the 'IBlockPoolMonitor' interface, along with a serializable 'ObjectPoolMonitorCounters' class used to track method call counters related to object pooling memory tracking.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of IBlockPoolMonitor which tracks memory allocation, release, and reporting by incrementing counters.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class containing counters for monitoring object pool events, marked with Orleans serialization attributes.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Increments the counter for memory objects allocated by cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Increments the counter for memory objects released from cache.
